Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the third step (its second turn) by misinterpreting the search results. The search results clearly identified a prominent Joseph McGrath as a Scottish film director born in Glasgow in 1928. The Planner incorrectly concluded that this figure was "associated with early cinema" and then fabricated a nonsensical normalization logic ("SC -> US-SC -> US") to force a conclusion that they were of the same nationality. In reality, Thomas H. Ince was American (born in Rhode Island, 1882) and the identified Joseph McGrath was Scottish (born in Glasgow, 1928), making them different nationalities. The Planner's failure to recognize the temporal and geographic discrepancy led to the wrong final answer.
